exact_existing_canonical_scope: For digit-parity Thue–Morse t, maximum monochromatic progression length A(d) and earliest maximum start i(d): d=2^n+1,n≥2 gives A=2^n+2,i=3·2^(2n)−2^n−1; d=2^(2n)−1,n≥1 gives A=2^(2n)+4,i=3·2^(4n)−2^(2n)+1; d=2^(2n+1)−1,n≥0 gives A=2^(2n+1),i=2^(2n+1)−1. Stronger all-start classifications are also proved. The first formula excludes n=1, since i(3)=45.
